title: Steiner symmetrization does not increase the diameter
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, j ∈ Fin d and let A ⊆ ℝ^d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) be compact. With y[j↦t] := y with its j-th coordinate replaced by t (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t)), A^j_y := {t ∈ ℝ : y[j↦t] ∈ A}, λ(y) := (L¹(A^j_y)).toReal and S_j(A) := {y ∈ ℝ^d : A^j_y ≠ ∅ and |y_j| ≤ λ(y)/2}, the extended diameters satisfy ediam S_j(A) ≤ ediam A.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (A : Set (Euclid d)), IsCompact A → ediam {y : Euclid d | {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |y j| ≤ (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal / 2} ≤ ediam A
